title: Output of Workday Jobs Scraper
description: One row per job in the default dataset; a per-site run summary in the OUTPUT record. Sites with no jobs get a free status row with a reason.

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.description: One row per job. Example: {"company":"NVIDIA","title":"Senior Software Engineer","location":"US, CA, Santa Clara","country":"United States","remote":false,"timeType":"Full time","postedDate":"2026-10-20","salaryMin":184000,"salaryMax":356500,"salaryCurrency":"USD","jobUrl":"https://nvidia.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/…"}. Status rows: {"status":"no_results","input":"…","jobsListed":800,"jobsMatched":0,"reason":"…"}.

summary.title: Run summary (per site)
summary.description: JSON: sites (status, jobsListed, jobsMatched, jobsSaved), jobsSaved, maxJobs, stoppedReason and zeroResultsReason.
